paragraphs.text: Preview and run Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) in the DSH better-sidebar file tree.
dsh-bsb-ipynb
Read, edit, run and save Jupyter notebooks inside the DSH Better Sidebar.
中文 · English
`dsh-bsb-ipynb` is a DSH Better Sidebar plugin that turns the sidebar's file tree into a Jupyter not
ebook workspace. Click any `.ipynb` to read, edit, run and save it as you would in Jupyter. Kernels
run in the host process through `jupyter_client` + `ipykernel`, so nothing Python-related runs in th
e browser and there is no build step.
## ✨ Features
- **Notebook rendering** — Markdown, code and raw cells with execution counts; streaming stdout/stde
rr, `text/html` (sanitized against an allow-list), PNG/JPEG/SVG (`image/jpg` is accepted as an alias
for `image/jpeg`), Markdown, JSON and ANSI-colored tracebacks. Images in Markdown and `text/html` o
utputs resolve the same way: `attachment:`, relative and Windows drive/UNC paths go through the host
file route, while `http(s)` and `data:image` sources load as-is (remote images are fetched from the

ir origin).
- **Cell editing** — click a cell to edit it; insert or delete cells, move them up/down,

switch cell types, preview Markdown, and clear one cell's or all outputs.
- **Execution** — one per
sistent kernel per notebook, keyed by file path, keeps variables alive across cells; Run all, interr

upt, restart and shut down.
- **Saving** — writes nbformat 4.5 with sha256-based optimistic concurre
ncy (conflicts return 409 and never overwrite); atomic writes through a same-directory temp file and

rename; autosave 1.5 s after edits.
- **Interpreter discovery** — checks `DSH_IPYNB_PYTHON`, conda
environments, `python3`/`python` on `PATH`, then DSH's bundled Python, and selects only environments
that provide `jupyter_client` + `ipykernel`. `DSH_IPYNB_PYTHON` must be an absolute path; a relativ
e or unusable value is still listed by `/ipynb/interpreters` with a reason but is never used. The la
unch config is built in-process, so a same-named system kernelspec cannot redirect the selected inte

rpreter.
- **DSH integration** — every colour follows the DSH theme: state colours, banners, links a
nd Python syntax highlighting consume `--dsw-alias-*` and Shiki variables, and cell/editor/output ty
pe follows the DSH text and code font settings (dark mode is the host palette for the theme setting
× OS scheme, with no plugin-side theme detection). UI strings are registered under the `dsh-bsb-ipyn

b` locale namespace and follow DSH's Chinese/English language preference.
[该节后续省略]
## 🚀 Quick Start
| Requirement | Version / notes |

| DSH | Web GUI **0.2.2-rc.1** or newer |
| dsh-better-sidebar | **0.30.x** (verified with 0.30.1; 0

.28.x targets DSH 0.2.1 and is not recommended) |
| Python | `jupyter_client` + `ipykernel`; verify
with `python3 -c "import jupyter_client, ipykernel"` (macOS/Linux) or `python -c "import jupyter_cli
ent, ipykernel"` (Windows) |
[代码示例省略，未执行]

1. Open DSH's plugin manager and install this repository folder as a local bundle.
2. Refresh the pa

ge (`Cmd+R` on macOS; `Ctrl+R` or `F5` on Windows).
3. Open any `.ipynb` from the right-hand file tr
ee; examples/demo.ipynb is a good first run.
> **Windows**: interpreter discovery looks for `python.exe`/`python3.exe` on `PATH` (Microsoft Store
app-execution aliases under `WindowsApps` are skipped), conda environments (`<env>\python.exe`) and
DSH's bundled Python. Set `DSH_IPYNB_PYTHON` to an **absolute** `python.exe` path when the interpre
ter lives elsewhere; read-only or locked notebooks reject saves with `write-blocked` (409) until the
file is writable again, and reading a file locked by another program returns `read-blocked` (409).
## 🖱️ Usage
| Action | Shortcut |

| Run the current cell | `Cmd/Ctrl + Enter` |
| Run and advance to the next cell | `Shift + Enter` |

| Insert a code cell below | `Alt + Enter` |
| Save | `Cmd/Ctrl + S` |
| Outdent the current line |

`Shift + Tab` |
| Leave edit mode | `Esc` |
Run (`Cmd/Ctrl + Enter`) and save (`Cmd/Ctrl + S`) shortcuts also work in reading mode while the not
ebook view is visible: the target is the focused cell, otherwise the cell you last edited or ran, an
d `Cmd/Ctrl + S` is intercepted so the browser's save dialog does not open. While editing, Tab inser
ts four spaces and Shift+Tab removes one indent unit. Every action is also available from the toolba
r (interpreter, Run all, interrupt, restart, save, reload, shut down kernel).
- Autosave pauses while a cell or Run all is running, so transiently cleared or partial outputs neve

r reach disk.
[该节后续省略]
## 🧱 Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Request path: browser `client.js` → better-sidebar `webServer` → `/ipynb/*` routes → `KernelManager`
→ `python/bridge.py` (JSONL) ↔ `ipykernel`.

## ⚠️ Known Limitations
- Python kernels only (nbformat 4.x). Interactive JavaScript outputs (ipywidgets, plotly, bokeh, …)

are not rendered; HTML is sanitized into static content.
- No `input()`: kernels start with `allow_s
tdin=False`, so calls fail immediately rather than hanging. `%%` cell magics and `!cmd`, `%pip`, `%c

d`, `%pwd` work.
- If the kernel is still unresponsive about 3 s after an interrupt, it is force-res

tarted and all variables and kernel state are lost.
- Results are written back by the client and per

sisted on save; the server never appends output in the background.
- No "new notebook" wizard yet: c

reate an empty `.ipynb` in the file tree or open an existing file.
- Workspace containment uses the
session cwd; when the active root is a linked git worktree, requests may return 403 (not supported y

et).
- **Path-error side channel** — for a path outside the session workspace, an existing and acces
sible target generally returns 403, while a missing or inaccessible target returns 404 (possibly wit
h a reason). An already-admitted same-user client can use this distinction to probe host path existe

nce or accessibility; it does not allow reading or writing outside the workspace.
- **Windows**: an
interrupt cannot reach ipykernel, so it force-restarts the kernel after about 3 s and clears all var
iables (the generic interrupt timeout above); read-only or locked notebooks reject saves with `write

-blocked` (409) and locked files fail reads with `read-blocked` (409).
- Very large outputs make bro
wser rendering slow; clear outputs or run in smaller chunks.
